records.name: Friends of Laurel Hill & West Laurel Hill Cemeteries
records.summary: The friends group that helps care for the two historic Laurel Hill cemeteries, one in Philadelphia and one in Bala Cynwyd. The public can join guided history tours and evening events on the grounds, and visitors can support the group's work with gifts.
records.what_you_do: Join a guided tour of Laurel Hill West, come to an evening event such as True Tales from the Tombs at Laurel Hill East, or support the group through the site's Join and Support page.

schedule.text: Public tours and an evening event in October 2026: a history tour of Laurel Hill West on Friday, October 9, 10 to 11:30 am, and True Tales from the Tombs at Laurel Hill East on Saturday, October 10, 7 to 10 pm

cost.text: No cost is shown for the tours or the October event on the page we read

first_step.how: Check the site's tours and events listings and come to a date that suits you; the page we read does not say whether tickets are needed
first_step.basis: The tours and evening events are listed publicly with dates and times

records.notes: The site runs the two cemeteries, the friends group and burial services together. Only the public tours, events and support options are recorded. Treated as a nonprofit friends group with public programs, not as a cemetery association. Gate hours on the site run 7 am to 7 pm in spring through fall.

records.name: EgoPo Classic Theater
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit theater company that stages its own season of plays on Dickinson Street. Patrons can buy single tickets, a season subscription, or a membership, and the company lists volunteer roles and school residencies.
records.what_you_do: Buy tickets to a production or join as a subscriber or member. The site also lists volunteering, internships and school residencies, but gives no details on how to apply.

cost.text: Subscriptions start at $80 for three shows; memberships start at $150; single ticket prices are not shown

first_step.how: Buy a single ticket or a subscription from the site, or contact the company about volunteering
first_step.basis: Anyone can buy tickets or join at a membership level, but the volunteer and internship steps are not described

records.notes: This is a professional repertory company, so community_theater is the closest tag rather than an exact fit. The site shows no dated items: it names a 33 season of immersions and a 26 to 27 season label without dates, so the status is probably_active, not active. Single ticket prices and volunteer details were not on the page.

records.name: G-Town Radio (WGGT-LP 92.9 FM)
records.summary: Germantown's community radio station, heard on 92.9 FM and online. It airs music shows, local news, podcasts and community events, and it sometimes hosts open talks with neighbors.
records.what_you_do: Tune in, sign up for the newsletter, or come to a community talk the station announces. The Get Involved page is where the station points people who want to help, but the page we read did not show what volunteering involves.

first_step.how: Sign up for the newsletter or come to a community talk the station announces; ask through the Get Involved page about volunteer roles
first_step.basis: The newsletter sign up and the announced community talks are open to anyone, but the volunteer steps are not shown on the page we read

records.notes: The news item dated August 31, 2026 announces the first of three community talks tied to an artist residency. The footer says 2025, which is not evidence. The upcoming programs list was empty when read. Search results (not opened) name Germantown United CDC, Germantown Life Enrichment Center and South Philadelphia Community Radio as sharing the 92.9 FM schedule; none was checked.

records.name: Moonstone Arts Center
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit for poetry and writing. It holds public readings, open mics, live broadcasts and author events around the city, and some of them are free.
records.what_you_do: Come to a public reading or an open mic, read your own poems at an open reading, or ask about the intern and volunteer roles the center lists.

schedule.text: Events listed for October 2026: a live broadcast on Tuesday, October 13 at 6:30 pm; a house poet night at Fergie's Pub on Wednesday, October 14 at 7 pm; a Black Poetry Day reading on Saturday, October 17, 4 to 11 pm; and a free live poetry night at Fergie's Pub on Wednesday, October 21, 7 to 9 pm

cost.text: Some events are free, including the October 21 poetry night; other prices are not shown

first_step.how: Pick a public event on the events page and come along; check the event page for who may read at an open reading
first_step.basis: Readings and an open poetry mic are listed as public events with dates and venues, so anyone can come

records.notes: Event dates and venues were read from the events page. The Black Poetry Day reading invites Black poets to read, so it is not open to every reader. The October 13 broadcast airs through PhillyCAM, which was not checked. The homepage gives 110A South 13th Street as the center's address; the Fergie's Pub and Perch venues are event locations, not the center's own space.

records.name: Nashirah: The Jewish Chorale of Greater Philadelphia
records.summary: An auditioned community choir that sings the full range of Jewish choral music for audiences in the Philadelphia area. New singers join by audition, and the site shows an audition poster for the 2026 to 2027 season.
records.what_you_do: Audition to join, sing in rehearsals, and perform in concerts. Members of the public can attend the concerts, though the page we read did not show ticket prices.

first_step.how: Watch the site for the audition details for the 2026 to 2027 season, or email the manager to ask how to audition
first_step.basis: Singers audition before joining, and the audition dates and sign up steps are not written out in the text of the page we read

records.notes: The address nashirah.org redirects to the WordPress address used here. The 2026 to 2027 audition poster is an image, so its details were not read, and no item on the page shows a month, so the status is probably_active, not active. The rehearsal venue is not published, so only the mailing address is listed.

records.name: Northeast Philadelphia Chinese Association (NEPCA)
records.summary: A small community nonprofit that works to help Asian American residents of Northeast Philadelphia with culture, education and the local economy. The website lists a team and volunteer page but few current programs.
records.what_you_do: Ask the association about volunteering through its volunteer page, or call or email to learn what it is running now. The site we read did not list classes, open events or membership.

first_step.how: Call or email the association to ask about volunteering and current activities
first_step.basis: A volunteer page exists, but the page we read gave no roles, dates or sign up steps, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: The newest dated item on the site is a July 2022 note marking a three year anniversary. Its blog and event calendar are linked but their contents were not shown. The site gives no street address, so none is published. Older news and a business directory give two different addresses (6434 Castor Ave and 6331 Shelbourne St); neither is confirmed on the site, so neither is used. The site names Culture Trust of Greater Philadelphia as its fiscal sponsor; not checked.

records.name: Narberth Community Theatre (NCT)
records.summary: A community theatre group that stages musicals and plays at Overbrook Presbyterian Church on City Avenue. Members vote on the theatre's business, and volunteers help with ushering, ticket sales, set building and stage crew.
records.what_you_do: Join as a member, which includes tickets to each show, or volunteer for ushering, greeting, ticket sales or stage work by contacting the theatre.

cost.text: Individual membership is $45 a year and family membership is $75; ticket prices are not shown on the pages read

first_step.how: Sign up for membership on the membership page, or call the theatre at 610-245-4525 to ask about volunteering
first_step.basis: Membership and volunteer roles are open to the public, but the volunteer page gives no sign up steps beyond contacting the theatre

records.notes: Status is dormant because the newest dated item the site shows is the 2021-2022 board page, with no month. The homepage lists three shows (Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat, Crazy For You, A Little Night Music) with no year, and the footer says copyright 2021. Confirm the current season with the theatre before trusting this status. The auditions page redirects in a loop and could not be read, so audition details are unknown. The name refers to Narberth, but the theatre's own directions page places it in Philadelphia.

records.name: Darlington Arts Center
records.notes: The site gives its address as 977 Shavertown Road, Garnet Valley, PA 19060. It says its outreach covers Delaware and Chester Counties and parts of Chester and West Chester, and lists no programs in Philadelphia. The newest explicit date on the site is October 28, 2023; the copyright 2026 footer is not evidence. Not published.

records.name: Main Line Art Center
records.notes: The site gives its address as 746 Panmure Road, Haverford, PA 19041, and names no program in Philadelphia. The newest dated item is a youth class running October 13 to December 1, 2026. Not published.

records.name: Montgomery County Chorale and Orchestra
records.notes: The site names Montgomery County as its base and gives a mailing address in Ambler. Its 29th season starts October 18, 2026. A GuideStar listing that appeared in search results names Philadelphia County in its service area; I did not open it. Reconsider only if a Philadelphia venue or program is confirmed. Not published.

records.name: Meridee Winters School of Music
records.notes: A private lesson business with an Ardmore studio and in-home lessons on the Main Line. Its showcases and holiday open mic are for students and are not described as open to the public. No community program was found. Ardmore is outside Philadelphia. Not published.
